result_summary.title: SSO Integration Module login loop in ANZ Staging
result_summary.description: In our ANZ staging environment, the SSO Integration Module is causing a login loop. Users attempt to log in, are redirected, and then returned to the login page without authenticating. This affects about 11 internal test users. The error manifests as a persistent redirect loop and eventual login failure. We are unable to proceed with testing until this SSO redirect issue is resolved.
